datasheet_identity.title: BZT52B2V4 THRU BZT52B51 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: All electrical-characteristic values are specified at TA = 25 °C unless otherwise noted.

The zener breakdown pairing is nominal VZ = 8.2 V at IZT = 5 mA; the same row publishes VZ minimum = 8.04 V and maximum = 8.36 V, which are retained as limits rather than substituted for the nominal fitted target.

Zener polarity follows the datasheet symbol and polarity marking: cathode is the positive terminal in reverse operation, and VZ is the reverse cathode-to-anode voltage at the stated reverse current IZT.
The reverse leakage value is the published maximum IR = 0.7 µA at VR = 5.0 V, not a typical value.
The forward-voltage value is the published maximum VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from the p. 1 maximum-ratings table; no target-specific forward-IV table was published.
No reverse-recovery time trr is published, so reverse recovery is omitted.
Figure 4 on p. 3 is a family-level typical capacitance plot with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias traces; no unambiguous target-specific capacitance value was extracted.
The family-level plots on p. 3 do not provide an unambiguous target-specific trace for BZT52B8V2, so no plotted points were invented or extracted.
omission_reason: The supplied PDF contains family-level plots, but no unambiguous target-specific plotted trace for BZT52B8V2; curves are therefore omitted. Capacitance and reverse recovery are also omitted because no target-specific tabulated capacitance or trr is published.
